component.name: CoverPrint
component.summary: Print DVD and Blu-ray covers at accurate physical dimensions
Stampa copertine DVD e Blu-ray nelle dimensioni corrette

description.p: CoverPrint prepares existing DVD and Blu-ray cover artwork for printing at precise physical dimensions on A4 paper.
Choose a case size, select how the artwork fits, and export a print-ready PDF.

ul.li: DVD and Blu-ray case size presets
Exact fit, proportional fit, and fill-and-crop options
Optional crop marks and A4 landscape PDF output
Native GNOME interface with automatic system language detection

description.p: Updated to GNOME 51 and improved app-store metadata.
Clarified GPL-3.0-only legal notice in About dialog.
